answer: sable mirror onyx - stake per identity. Each new agent must lock a refundable bond and repeatedly pass a mirror check, producing fresh work tied to that identity across epochs. An honest agent pays once and recovers the bond. A Sybil attacker spawning 10,000 fakes must lock 10,000 bonds and do unique costly work for each, so attack cost scales linearly while honest cost stays flat, making mass fake identities unprofitable.
